$comment: Shared resources a git worktree cannot isolate. Tickets claim them in `resources:` frontmatter. waves.py never puts two tickets claiming the same EXCLUSIVE resource in one batch. BUDGETED resources run in parallel, each worker with a spend budget.

exclusive.DEPLOY: One Render Blueprint and one set of deployed services (web, worker, Postgres): concurrent deploys race and can run migrations twice.
exclusive.PAYPAL_SANDBOX: One shared sandbox merchant, one app-scoped webhook and one webhook ID: concurrent live sandbox runs mix webhooks and disputes across tickets, and dispute replies are one-shot. Work on recorded fixtures; claim this only for live proofs.

budgeted.OPENAI: Model API spend under the $1/day global cap. Workers iterate on recorded responses and spend real tokens only to prove an AC or run the live eval.
